mutants.name: fallback-removed
mutants.why: removing the fallback means a CANTOPEN on mode=ro propagates to every caller; t1 expects query_in_flight to return rows via the fallback, so it raises instead

mutants.name: mode-ro-removed
mutants.why: skipping the mode=ro attempt means the helper always uses a plain connection; t2 expects exactly one file: call (the mode=ro attempt) to be recorded, but gets zero

mutants.name: query-only-dropped
mutants.why: omitting PRAGMA query_only=1 allows the fallback connection to write; t4 expects INSERT to raise 'readonly' but it succeeds instead
